{{Quotation|game|The Gate of the Nightfallen Lands is the entrance to [[Abaddon]]'s staging ground for his ultimate invasion of the living world. Beyond the gate lies the dark god's corrupted, nightmarish versions of reality, which will eventually overlay onto the real world, bringing about Nightfall and extending Abaddon's Realm of Terror into the lands of Elona and beyond.}}

The [[Gate of the Nightfallen Lands]] represents the heart of an expanding nightmarish realm that mirrors the lands of [[Elona]], starting from [[Kourna]].

==Getting there==
This outpost is in [[Nightfallen Jahai]], the [[explorable area]] between the [[Gate of Torment]] and the [[Gate of Pain (outpost)|Gate of Pain]].

It is more towards the north, so it will be a shorter distance from the Gate of Pain (if already unlocked). Travel in a west by southwest direction from the gate of Pain, or a north by northwest direction from the Gate of Torment.

The [[secondary quest]] [[Drink of the Gods]] leads to a spot close to this outpost.
